verdict.rationale: Fastmail's programmatic API is JMAP, accessible with API tokens and documented in its own API docs. JMAP lets a client POST a `methodCalls` array to query, fetch and send in one HTTP request, and sync often needs only a single roundtrip. That shows batched multi-operation requests, but the evidence never shows bulk mutation (move, flag or delete) across many items. Filters & Rules appears only as a page title, with no detail on applying actions to many messages. missing for 10: explicit documentation of bulk set/update operations across many messages, UI bulk-action evidence, limits on batch size, independent or hands-on corroboration of bulk workflows.
